main_text.p: ardiæ constituto. Hinc post annos xviiij, anno scilicet M[?] cccc. xliv, Ost-broec-sterani, Collumani, Suachii, Oldwol-dii, Gastii pacti cum civitate Fœdus cū Collumanis. Gronin-ganâ sunt in hanc sententiam: Si judices ipsorum in coercendis maleficiis officium non facerent, jus esset senatui urbano, & Hovet-mannis, mandare iis, ut facerent: Si ne-tum quidem moveri se sinerent, citarentur ab iisdem GRONINGAM, ad conven-tum juridicum: & causa cognita, si cessasse in officio deprehenderentur, multam gra-vem poscerentur; & ad solvendam eam com-pellerentur. Nec multis interjectis diebus Fœdus cū omnibus Oftergois quadrienne[?] omnes Ostergoi, ut se domesticis turbis ac dissensionibus perpetuis liberarent, cum frustra id prius pactionibus inter se, & cum Westergois vicinis quæsissent propter factionum pertinaciam sæpè pa-cta perrumpentem, ad hujus ejusdem civitatis Gronin-gana societatem confuge-runt, conventumque juridicum ad cogno-scendas controversias majores, de quibus pro-vocatum ab xviii-viris judicibus superi-oribus, curandaque negotia Reip. agendum semel quotannis Groningæ collocarunt. Ad hæc

page.notes: Page 121. The first word "ardiæ" is a fragment from the previous line and stays as printed. The Roman numeral "M[?]" is printed as "M" followed by a mark I could not identify, so it is marked as doubtful. "quadrienne" in the right-hand margin is set in small italic and is uncertain. A reference mark, a small curved sign, stands before "Ad" in the last line, and a small mark appears at the foot of the page to the left; neither is clearly linked to a printed note, so neither is transcribed. "hæc" at the foot is the catchword, the first word of the following page.
